evidenceSource: pred.gg public match stream (get-matches-since), RANKED, patch 1.17.2: ordered 3-item cores (first three completed Epic items by purchase time; anyOrder rows group a set whose orders were each under the floor), 20+ games each, counted 2026-10-14T18:34 -> 2026-10-16T01:17; hero-wide + per-role. Counted by npm run perks.
method: 100 stratified crit sequences; high-health diagnostic target; three-item cores with actual costs. First two scenarios fix attack opportunities to isolate mechanics. Third uses each build attack rate with zero cast recovery: an optimistic contact ceiling, not a feasible measured combo. No Purge or Dash. Ablations retain item stats and stat conversions; only replay event behavior is disabled. Deltas interact and must not be added together. Removing Vengeance also removes Dusk eligibility.
limitations: Controlled action replay, not a fight policy or win-probability model. Hit times/raw payloads/crit outcomes are explicit scenario inputs.
Vengeance and shred stacks refresh together; damage uses pre-hit stacks, then applies new stacks. Trigger ordering needs gameplay confirmation.
Secondary item/passive packets do not recursively trigger stack effects. Purge tick count and per-tick triggers are not inferred.

Solaris uses the triggering hit critical outcome. Ashbringer reduces active non-ultimate cooldowns on each basic or Mercy hit. Native EventDataFloat scaling remains assumed to be one; nonbasic critical/Purge triggers remain omitted.
Ruination drains uniformly over four seconds; refresh extends the existing drain rate. Tick cadence and refresh behavior require gameplay confirmation.
Power ratios use the current engine bonus-power basis. Healing is potential output, not effective healing or shield value.
Knell, augments, Dash power/reset stacks, actor mana budgets, projectile travel, attack animations, misses, incoming damage and target healing are excluded.
Vanquisher uses the inclusive post-damage threshold; this replay has no target shield state or native execute-damage model.
All Tainted Rounds on-hit damage, anti-heal value, Terminus overheal shields and Manta farming stacks remain omitted.

skipped.name: Vanquisher / OnixianQuiver / Scattershot
limitations: Onixian Quiver / Multishot + Onixia: Multishot is not simulated: angled projectiles scale with travel distance and hero basic scaling. Recovered effect defaults bind attack-damage scaling and the custom distance calculation. Collision, critical-strike/lifesteal resolution and complete native aggregation still need integration. Melee Onixia crit and missing-health mitigation are also omitted; ranged carries receive no melee benefit.

Scattershot / Scatter: Scattershot is not simulated: its filtered on-hit trigger attempts two nearby-target projectiles behind a cooldown gate. Defaults recover the target filter, radius and damage/on-hit bindings; the shared damage path passes its captured on-hit percentage through event data. Target selection, collision, critical-strike resolution and downstream passive interactions still need integration. The second attempt can retain the first target; neither zero nor two extra hits on the original target is verified.
